scope: Independent review of root aggregation, lossless source-registry normalization, frozen provenance, observed graph arithmetic, all eight STEP3 documents, decision/acceptance references and declared architecture models.

checks.details: Actual Draft202012 schema, unique stable IDs and canonical four-domain sorting.
Workspace requested dictionary copy equals output dictionary bytes.
Strict edges require import/call/type basis and currently originate only in source_observed records; documentation/inferred edges remain separate. Counts do not prove runtime connectivity.

details.review_method: Read all eight documents; verify current-vs-proposed boundaries and traceability to dictionary/source scope.

details.claim_scope: Exactly the declared proposed graph; not source-discovered authority or verified implementation mediation.

details.interpretation: Atomicity is an explicit assumption. No actual concurrency implementation, scheduler, SQLite or filesystem transaction was exercised.

details.contract: Interrupted unacknowledged publication may recover old or new; an acknowledged commit cannot revert merely because of a crash. These are abstract acceptance states, not fault-injection results.

details.method: Privately re-read actual frozen code for critical judge/emitter, JSON-error/UI status, ignored DB result and path/shell claims. MBSD signature/stub claims were inspected during contribution. No project code executed.

resolved_during_review: Qualified one logical local-head authority per workspace replica.
Unknown judge returning OK is a verdict counterexample, not alone an effect trace.
Distinguished pre-ack old/new recovery from durability of acknowledged commits.
Stated at-most-one distinct successful publication from the same expected generation.

details.manual_review: Eight documents consistently separate current source observations, proposed transitions, local mathematical models, future independent acceptance, and missing native/hardware integration. Omnia desktop v1 remains distinct from umbrella/mobile/research scope.

graph_analysis.interpretation: Selected evidence graph is disconnected; it cannot mathematically establish one existing universal runtime center. No exhaustive absence inference follows.

limitations: This reviewer contributed MBSD records; independence here applies to root aggregation, registry normalization, graph arithmetic and STEP3 inference review.
Source hash/line checks establish provenance, not correctness of every semantic interpretation.
No source builds, runtime, deployment, model inference or hardware tests were performed.
The proposed minimum vertex cut is a property of the declared ten-node graph, not a theorem that only one system architecture is possible.
The two atomic CAS orders and six durability oracle cases are finite reference-model checks. Actual crash/concurrency/provider/native-adapter behavior remains NOT_EXECUTED.
Native three-model integration absence is bounded to recorded inventories/commits; unrelated branches and external binaries are not ruled out.
delivery_scope: MASTER_PLAN assembly is checked. External chat delivery and final archive assembly are subsequent operations and are not claimed completed by this report.
